Com o país, a moeda do plano passa à do: With the country, the plan currency becomes the country’s (you can choose another) and the assumptions use the country reference data. You can change any value.
Onde fica a rede e qual é o nome dela?: Where is the network and what is its name?
O país define a moeda do plano e os dado: The country sets the plan currency and the reference data used in the suggestions. The name appears on the plan cover and in the documents you take to the team.
Em que moeda o plano será apresentado?: In which currency will the plan be presented?
Os valores de referência estão em dólare: Reference values are in dollars and are converted at the exchange rate of {data} ({fonte}), which you can replace. Values in different currencies are never added: the whole plan stays in the chosen currency.
A governança entra igual nas duas coluna: Governance enters both columns equally; the difference between them is that of education with and without AI. Each priority uses its own phases and additional costs, shown in the sections below.
Desafios, público, fases e custos de cad: Challenges, population, phases and costs of each challenge
Plano do programa: governança e educação: Programme plan: governance and education with and without AI
Viagens, custos indiretos e taxa adminis: Travel, indirect costs and administrative fee for both priorities
Custo já calculado: os valores de referê: Cost already calculated: the reference values suggested by the tool and the values you entered, which replace the suggestion.
Lidera o trabalho e acompanha a norma at: Leads the work and follows the regulation through approval and publication, which usually take longer than the drafting.
Traz a prática de proteção de dados, def: Brings data protection practice, defines the procedures and remains responsible for them throughout the plan.
Configura as rotinas de cópia, faz os te: Sets up the backup routines, runs the periodic restore tests and records the results.
Não se aplica: o plano não lança o custo: Does not apply: the plan does not include the training cost.
Estudantes que já têm dispositivo: Students who already have a device
